name: -6 AN 90 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting
title: -6 AN 90 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting
description:
The -6 AN 90 Degree Female Push-Loc Fitting is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings Push-Loc Hose End Fittings are precision CNC-machined for secure, clamp-free connections in low- to medium-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, PCV, vacuum, and air systems. Designed specifically for Push-Loc (barbed) hose, these fittings provide a tight, leak-resistant seal without the need for hose clamps in most applications, making them ideal for clean, efficient engine bay plumbing.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: Premium high-grade construction with corrosion-resistant coating.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
